description: This file defines the ApiKeysTableConfig class, which configures the display and management of API keys in the UI, including fetching, adding, editing, enabling/disabling, and deleting API keys.

classes.name: ApiKeysTableConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for the API Keys table, managing CRUD operations, status display, and UI interactions for API keys.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Configures action buttons for each API key row, such as enable/disable toggle.

methods.name: addApiKey
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new API key and handles post-creation actions.

methods.name: apiKeyGenerated
methods.description: Displays the generated API key in a dialog after creation.

methods.name: toggleEnableMode
methods.description: Enables or disables an API key based on user interaction.

methods.name: apiKeyStatus
methods.description: Returns HTML string representing the current status of an API key.

methods.name: apiKeyStatusStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for API key status indicator.

methods.name: updateApiKeyDescription
methods.description: Opens a popover to edit the API key description and updates data upon completion.
